vix_rebuild

Rebuild a vector index from the vector members of records, and print digests of vector indexes (DataReel 7.4).

Contents

Usage
Examples

Usage

vix_rebuild --data DATA.gxd --index OUT.vix --member infohog:N|offset:N [--tags A,B,C,D]
            [--like OLD.vix | --dim D --element f32|f16|i8 --metric l2|cosine|ip --m M --efc N --spec TEXT]
vix_rebuild --digest FILE.vix [--digest-kind logical|bytes]

The rebuild reads every record of the data file in ascending address order and makes the index from their vector members (gxvmember.h), so it is the same file, byte for byte, on every node: what a replicated copy runs as its derived_rebuild. The header (dimension, element type, metric, M, ef_construction, spec) comes from --like, or from OUT.vix itself when it exists, or from --dim, --element, --metric, --m, --efc and --spec. Exit 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 usage.

--digest prints "logical HASH NODES FILE": a hash of the live nodes in id order (id, stored code, tags), the same for two indexes that hold the same nodes whatever their graphs; --digest-kind bytes hashes the file's bytes (for rebuild against rebuild). The example vector_records calls the same rebuild from code.

Examples

The files of the vector_records example: items.gxd holds 600 records with a float16 vector member at offset 32 and tags at offsets 28 and 24, and items.vix is their index. The logical digest of the index, then a rebuild from the records alone, with the header taken from the old index:

$ vix_rebuild --digest items.vix
logical bd3c19f6cd85d91c 600 items.vix opt 1

$ vix_rebuild --data items.gxd --index parts.vix --member offset:32 --tags offset:28,-,offset:24,- --like items.vix
vix_rebuild: parts.vix: 600 records, 600 nodes

$ vix_rebuild --digest parts.vix
logical bd3c19f6cd85d91c 600 parts.vix opt 3

The logical digests are equal, so the rebuilt index holds the same nodes and tags. "opt" is the optional format bits of the index: 1 keeps tag ranges, 2 marks an index rebuilt from record members. The bytes digests differ, because the two graphs were built in a different order; two rebuilds of the same data have the same bytes digest:

$ vix_rebuild --digest items.vix --digest-kind bytes
bytes 5bb78b0992e1cb6e 230392 items.vix
$ vix_rebuild --digest parts.vix --digest-kind bytes
bytes 05053735863893a0 230392 parts.vix
